summary.content:
Today's selection covers 102 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Why the Hugging Face Hack Should Make You Worry More About A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Large Enterprises Targeted in Fake Merger & Acquisition Scams
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 50 articles published in the last 24 hours
